verdicts.explanation: The value quoted as a phone number, 103.142.225.136, is the requester's own IP address from the page's __NEXT_DATA__ payload (the JSON key is "ip"), not a phone number withheld from the visible text.

The homepage's only JSON-LD type is WebSite, with no Organization or LocalBusiness block and no sameAs links anywhere in the 12-page crawl, so the brand has no anchor distinguishing it from others sharing the name.
The about-us page has 7 images and 6 of them carry no alt attribute, matching the scripted count exactly.
